shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,240p' .agents/skills/mempal-memory/SKILL.md && printf '\\n--- status ---\\n' && git status --short && printf '\\n--- files ---\\n' && rg --files | head -80"
/bin/bash -lc 'mempal search "react-hook-form async validation stale isValid isValidating resolver" --json --top-k 5'

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"_setValid\\(\" src/logic/createFormControl.ts && sed -n '1180,1250p' src/logic/createFormControl.ts && sed -n '1710,1825p' src/logic/createFormControl.ts && rg -n \"async function|const validate|validate =\" src/logic/createFormControl.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '370,420p' src/logic/createFormControl.ts; sed -n '580,650p' src/logic/createFormControl.ts; sed -n '1435,1500p' src/logic/createFormControl.ts; sed -n '1925,1960p' src/logic/createFormControl.ts"
/bin/bash -lc "git diff -- src/logic/createFormControl.ts && git log -5 --oneline && sed -n '1,80p' package.json && nl -ba src/logic/createFormControl.ts | sed -n '205,255p'"
/bin/bash -lc 'git diff --check && git status --short && git diff --stat && git diff -- src/logic/createFormControl.ts'

/bin/bash -lc 'mkdir -p "$HOME/.mempal-notes" && cat > "$HOME/.mempal-notes/react-hook-form-validity-ordering.md" <<'"'EOF'
# Guard aggregate async validity commits by generation

When aggregate form validity checks are launched fire-and-forget and await resolver or field validation, capture a monotonic generation at launch. Only the newest generation should publish "'`isValid`; resolver validation cleanup must use the same guard so a stale completion cannot clear a newer pass'"'s "'`isValidating` state.
EOF
mempal ingest "$HOME/.mempal-notes" --wing memory-evals'
